# nilpotent group　`def.nilpotent-group`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.nilpotent-group)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.nilpotent-group.md)

⭐ Nilpotent $\implies$ solvable: inductively $\gamma_i \subseteq G^{(i)}$, so the derived series terminates no later than the lower central series. The converse fails ($S_3$ is solvable but not nilpotent).

⚠ Subgroups and quotients of a nilpotent group are nilpotent, but extensions need not be.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
